citations.A1: Root cause: `_cache` is populated once and never invalidated — module-level memoization with no expiry, so disk changes are invisible until process restart.
citations.A2: Tempting non-fix: adding a TTL/short cache timeout — masks the bug, still serves stale data within the window
citations.A3: Tempting non-fix: clearing `_cache` manually elsewhere in code — relies on every writer remembering to do it; misses external edits to the file.
